content: Unraid ecosystem evidence: CA Backup/Appdata.Backup plugin (Commifreak repo, feature-frozen) backs up whole appdata per container without subfolder selection. Community workaround guide (Glasti1/unraid-plex-backup-fine-tuning): to avoid backing up volatile Plex data users physically MOVE Cache/Transcode/Sync+, Cache/PhotoTranscoder, Media, Metadata folders outside appdata, add container bind-mounts for them, and hand-write two cron'd User Scripts (important DBs daily, less-important media twice weekly). Strong proof of demand for subfolder exclusion inside a single mount.
